annotations.title: Check an x402 endpoint before paying it

description: [Kyreos, 0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base] x402 payment endpoint test: checks that a paid route answers, quotes a valid 402, has a sane price and a real payTo, all before your agent pays. Input: {"url":"https://host/route"}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/x402-precheck?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.002 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.002 USDC on Base)
